features.title: Search: airing-soon pool keeps each show's next episode with its resolved time (D-43)
criteria: TVmaze schedule items decode airtime, airdate, season and number
each candidate show keeps its soonest upcoming episode, resolved with TimeResolver and the bundled rules; an empty airtime is never exact (D-25)
'still to come' is judged by the resolved time, never the raw airstamp; a date-only episode stays through its airdate in the viewer's zone (D-28)
episodes released together keep the lowest season and episode, so a new season keeps episode 1
schedules are fetched from the viewer's yesterday to two days ahead, because TVmaze dates an episode in its own country
the pool keeps every qualifying show, by TVmaze weight then name; the 15-show cap applies only after filtering
features.verify: AiringSoonTests over the recorded schedules of 30 Oct 2026 (Apple TV placeholder airtime '' at 12:00Z, CBS broadcast, Peacock date-only, Netflix season drop, Paramount+ E10-E13 batch): resolved times, confidence, order, date-only day, tie-break, no placeholder kept after its real release, Auckland asks for yesterday

features.title: Search: filter logic for Today, New seasons, Exact time known and Service (D-43)
criteria: Today: still to come and on the viewer's calendar day in the zone times are formatted in (TimeZone.current; the Settings override once it exists); a date-only episode counts when its airdate is today
New seasons: the kept episode is episode 1 of any season (TV) or episode 1 (anime), brand-new shows included
Exact time known (TV only): the time would read 'Out', not 'Expected' (D-40); date-only never counts

Service (TV only): one at a time; a show's service is its web channel, else its network, matched by name; options come from the whole pool so a chosen one never disappears, most shows first, ties A-Z, at most 6
filters combine (AND), keep the popular-first order and show at most 15
changing a filter makes no TVmaze or AniList request; anime offers Today and New seasons only
features.verify: SearchFilterTests (a pure function over the D3-8 pool and the D3-8b AniList fixture, fixed clock, Africa/Lagos, America/New_York and Pacific/Auckland): each filter alone, combinations, the service list, the 15 cap, the anime subset; grep shows the filter type has no client dependency
